_why: The structural visual snapshot of all 46 micro-focus scenes at both placement widths, read by `npm run check:micro-visuals` (`scripts/check_micro_visuals.mjs`). Each scene is measured in a 477 px side stage and a 966 px bottom stage. Text, text-run boxes, element tags, element boxes, resolved visual-style fingerprints and SVG markup are recorded; a box is compared with a 2 px tolerance, text and fingerprints exactly. It is not a pixel diff: the Linux runner and the author’s machine do not rasterise type identically, while this structure is portable. A measurement issue — overflow, clipped text, an element outside the card — is never recorded and always fails. Re-record with `npm run check:micro-visuals -- --record` when a visual change is intended, and read the diff: it is the list of what moved.
